source_text: In mense secundo murmur de fame. Dominus pluit manna. Panis de caelo — Verbum; singulis diebus colligendum.
pass_a_gloss: In month second murmur about hunger. Lord rained manna. Bread from heaven — Word; on-single days to-be-gathered.
pass_b_english: In the second month rises the murmur of hunger; the Lord rains [[manna >> Bible:Exodus 16:4]]. Bread from heaven is the Word — gathered day by day.
